title: A Capturing Race
intro: These two groups are short of liberties. Count each group's liberties and check whose turn it is.

steps.instruction: Each group has one liberty. Black to play: capture White.
steps.hint: There is exactly one empty point touching the white stones.
steps.explanation: Black fills White's last liberty first. The captured white stones leave Black more space.

steps.instruction: Black has one liberty and White has two. Extend Black into space.
steps.hint: Extend along the top edge, away from the fight.
steps.explanation: Extending gives Black another liberty. Capturing races can change when a group finds more room.

steps.instruction: Black has two liberties; White has one. Capture White.
steps.hint: The same point as before. It is White's last one.
steps.explanation: White is captured when Black fills its last liberty.

outro: Count again after each move. Extensions, connections and captures can all change the liberties.
